title: A report on work trips
description: A checked period, the categories and the original records in a convenient file.

blocks.text: An automatic list of routes still has to be sorted through. What matters for the accounting that follows is the purpose of the trip and the ability to check the total.

quote.text: This app saved me in an audit. Otherwise I would have had to write a log of 3 years of driving for work. Thanks MileIQ.

blocks.text: Add categories, bulk editing within an explicit filter, and an itemized export. Show the unsorted trips until the report is finished.
Formats and requirements depend on where this is used. Do not promise a finished tax return or the size of a deduction on the strength of recorded mileage alone.
